title: CWP/4824/2025 of LAKHWINDER SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB
text:
CWP-4824-2025 and 1 other connected cases IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 113+114 Date of decision: 24.03.2025 1) CWP-4824-2025 Lakhwinder Singh vs. State of Punjab 2) CWP-5677-2025 (O&M) Malook Singh and others vs. State of Punjab 3) CWP-6907-2025 Anju Bala and others vs. State of Punjab CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMAN CHAUDHARY Present : Mr. G.S. Aulakh, Advocate for Mr. I.S. Dhaliwal, Advocate for the petitioner in CWP-4824-2025. Mr. Jatinderpal Singh, Advocate for petitioner No.1 in CWP-5677-2025. Mr. Anil Mehta, Advocate for petitioner Nos.2 to 4 in CWP-5677-2025. Mr. Rajiv Atma Ram, Senior Advocate with Mr. Abhaypal Singh Gill, Advocate for the petitioners in CWP-6907-2025. Mr. Manipal Singh Atwal, DAG, Punjab. AMAN CHAUDHARY, J. (Oral)

1. These cases involve similar issues and therefore, are being disposed of together by this common order.

2. In pursuance of order dated 18.03.2025, learned State counsel, on instructions from Ms. Sonali Giri, Secretary Revenue, Punjab, states that the order impugned in the present petitions shall be withdrawn forthwith, so as to pass afresh after granting opportunity of hearing to the petitioners and in the meantime, they are required to report to the concerned Financial Commissioner, Department of Revenue, Punjab for the purpose of their posting as Naib Tehsildar, which satisfies the learned counsel for the petitioners. CWP-4824-2025 and 2 other connected cases

3. Disposed of accordingly.

4. A photocopy of this order be placed on the files of connected cases. (AMAN CHAUDHARY) JUDGE 24.03.2025 Hemant
